scenario.name: Draft and save a README with selection-based markup
scenario.objective: Turn a plain draft into a saved README.md whose formatting exists only as markup characters, verifying the derived preview before saving
workflow: Paste or open a plain-text draft of the README into the source editor
Select a phrase and use the Bold button, then select a line and use the H1 button, so markup is inserted around the selection
Glance at the live preview pane to confirm the heading and emphasis render as intended
Save, downloading the .md file, and reopen it to confirm the stored text is the markup itself
acceptance: The downloaded .md file contains the literal markup characters and no styling data
The preview is recomputed from the saved text and shows the same heading and bold phrase
Word and character counts update to reflect the rendered source

license_uncertainties: Design reference only; no source code copied; file-level exceptions not exhaustively audited.
excluded_paths: Unselected files; upstream not installed or run

feedback.error: independent review did not pass; retain candidate and findings

observations.reason: index.js 253-268 shows the switch cases: bold maps to '**'/'**' and h1 maps to '# '/''; the fixed prefix/suffix claim is accurate.

index.js 319-336 rebuilds the textarea value from the pre-selection text, the selected substring wrapped by the prefix/suffix, and the post-selection text, then sets the selection by adding the prefix length; accurate.
index.js 197-211 reads #getm.value, replaces every LF with CRLF, creates a Blob of type text/plain, and downloads it as marcdown.md; accurate.
index.js 73-84 reads viewer.innerText, removes whitespace with /\s+/gi for the character count, and sets both counts to zero and save.disabled=true when the text is empty; accurate.
index.js 87-96 takes the buffer HTML, runs marked.parse, highlights code blocks, and swaps buffer and viewer so the visible pane contains the parsed result; accurate.

index.html 162-179 does not show a hidden #buffer: line 177 places style='display: none;' on #viewer, while the #buffer div at line 179 has no hidden style; index.js 40-47 swaps visibility at runtime. The specific 'hidden #buffer' claim is inaccurate.
README.md 63-69 contains the demo link and the steps to paste/type markdown on the left, view the preview on the right, and save the markdown file; accurate.

issues: Blocking: acceptance/probe.py A01 'empty selections and blank lines' (lines 99-100) requires applyMarkup({text:'',start:0,end:0},'h1') to return '# ', but VIEW_ARCH.md section 4 (lines 33-34; also section 9 line 81) says blank lines are untouched and that if no non-blank line intersects, text and selection are returned unchanged. An empty document has no non-blank line. A core conforming to the architecture returns '' and fails A01; a core passing A01 violates the architecture. The probe and the architecture must be reconciled.

Blocking: the probe's negative assertions only call throws() (probe.py lines 54-58, used at 109-111 and 166-169), so any exception satisfies them. They never assert the explicit error codes INVALID_SELECTION, UNKNOWN_ACTION, EMPTY_DOCUMENT, INVALID_FILENAME, FILE_TOO_LARGE, or INVALID_CONTENT defined in VIEW_ARCH.md lines 35 and 55-58. A core throwing generic Errors would pass. A03 also covers only LF (probe.py 161-162), and no test covers non-string openText, so section 7's INVALID_CONTENT and CRLF-preservation rules are unverified.

Blocking source-fidelity finding: observation 5 cites index.html 162-179 but the hidden element in that range is #viewer (line 177), not #buffer (line 179); the buffer/viewer visibility is swapped by index.js 40-47. The observation overstates the fixed hidden state of #buffer.
review.summary: The leaf scope, target architecture, design distinction from the upstream CDN/MathJax app, scenario journey, and explicit limits are otherwise coherent. The delivery is not ready: A01 contains a direct empty-document H1 contradiction with the architecture, the probe does not verify the explicit error-code contract, and observation 5 misidentifies the hidden upstream element. Verdict: needs_changes.

revision.scope: Fix existing core violations only; preserve fixed scenario, sources and delivery profile.
